records.before: ತವೋಪಾಸಕಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂತಾ ನ ಚಿತ್ರಂ ಜನೇಭ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಸಂಸ್ಪರ್ಶನೈರ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮದಾ ವೈ । ಸುರೇನ್ದ್ರಾದಿಪೂಜ್ಯಾ ಗಣೇಶಸ್ವರೂಪಾ ಭವೇಯುರ್ನಮಸ್ತೇ ನಮಸ್ತೇ ಗಣೇಶ ॥೪೬॥
records.source_reading: तवोपासका ब्रह्मभूता न चित्रं जनेभ्यश्च संस्पर्शनैर्ब्रह्मदा वै । सुरेंद्रादिपूज्या गणेशस्वरूपा भवेयुर्नमस्ते नमस्ते गणेश ॥४६॥
records.notes: Current Kannada-script Sanskrit agrees with the inspected source, allowing homorganic nasal/anusvara orthographic equivalence. Preserve न चित्रं and the plural devotees becoming Brahman and bestowing Brahman by contact. No new defect demonstrated.

records.before: ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲುಬು ಮತ್ತು ಚರ್ಮ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿದು, ಉಸಿರಷ್ಟೇ ಉಳಿದ, ಅಂಗಗಳು ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸಿದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆಯೂ ಹುತ್ತವು ಆವರಿಸಿತ್ತು. ॥೪೮॥
records.source_reading: अस्थित्वचासमायुक्तं श्वासमात्रावशेषितम् । हीनांगमावृतं तत्र वल्मीकेन समंततः ॥४८॥
records.notes: The original supports the current bones/skin, remaining breath, emaciated limbs and surrounding anthill rendering. No duration occurs in48. Nearby43 clearly reads दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं, a thousand divine years, matching current context43. The packet question’s ten-year suggestion is unsupported by these pixels; do not relocate or introduce it.

records.before: ಉಮಾಕಾಂತ ನಮಸ್ತುಭ್ಯಂ ಭಕ್ತಸಂರಕ್ಷಕಾಯ ಚ । ಭಕ್ತಿಪ್ರಿಯಾಯ ದೇವಾಯ ಸರ್ಪಧಾರಾಯ ತೇ ನಮಃ । ॥೧೪॥
records.source_reading: उमाकांत नमस्तुभ्यं भक्तसंरक्षकाय च । भक्तिप्रियाय देवाय सर्पहाराय ते नमः ॥१४॥
records.proposed_full_replacement: ಉಮಾಕಾಂತ ನಮಸ್ತುಭ್ಯಂ ಭಕ್ತಸಂರಕ್ಷಕಾಯ ಚ । ಭಕ್ತಿಪ್ರಿಯಾಯ ದೇವಾಯ ಸರ್ಪಹಾರಾಯ ತೇ ನಮಃ । ॥೧೪॥
records.notes: Original clearly has सर्पहाराय (serpent garland), not सर्पधाराय. Correct only this lexical element; current vocative ಉಮಾಕಾಂತ is already supported. This resolves the base-source transcription question; no alternate printed edition inspected.

records.before: ಸದಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಮಯಾಯೈವ ನಮೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪ್ರದಾಯಿನೇ । ನಿರಾಧಾರಾಯ ನಿತ್ಯಾಯ ಸುದೀಪ್ತಾತ್ಮನೇ ನಮಃ । ॥೧೮॥
records.source_reading: सदा ब्रह्ममयायैव नमो ब्रह्मप्रदायिने । निराधाराय नित्याय सुयोगिपतये नमः ॥१८॥
records.proposed_full_replacement: ಸದಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಮಯಾಯೈವ ನಮೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪ್ರದಾಯಿನೇ । ನಿರಾಧಾರಾಯ ನಿತ್ಯಾಯ ಸುಯೋಗಿಪತಯೇ ನಮಃ । ॥೧೮॥
records.notes: Original clearly has सुयोगिपतये, lord of excellent yogis, not सुदीप्तात्मने. Replace this epithet only. Historical supplied quotation agrees, but the justification is independent inspection of the original.

records.before: ಮತ್ಸರನ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ದೈತ್ಯರು ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿದರು. ಧರ್ಮದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನೂ ಕುರಿತು ಭಾವಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಮಾತಾಡಿದರು. ॥೪೧॥
records.source_reading: मत्सरस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दैत्यास्ते त्वब्रुवन् वचः । अखिलं धर्मकरणं बाधादं भावपूर्वकम् ॥४१॥
records.notes: First Kannada sentence is supported. Second generic discussion of all matters of dharma fails to represent the visible बाधादं obstruction/harm element. However धर्मकरणं with अखिलं/बाधादं and वचः is compressed and its attachment remains unsettled. Context39–43 confirms a reply countering the mother’s injunction, but does not settle a complete grammatical rendering. No confident exact replacement proposed. Retention is a hold, not a clean accuracy confirmation; do not emend the Sanskrit or add a negation.
